`library-only`: V13 clause (b)'s safeguarded Anderson recycle and V14 (c)'s edges E1 and E2 are tested library capabilities, not application paths.
T08.A34's audit did not separately cover the certificates the replays re-emit.

The RC records: 42 of the 44 the RC record cites are committed under `evidence/T08/67c66d98587f23bd7dfe8da28a8facccc92da21e/rc/` (Amendment R7 1); the two ensemble run files (2.4 MB each) exist on one host (git-ignored) and as CI artifacts with finite retention.
Bitwise reproduction is reported, never promised (ADR 0007 F1); portability beyond Linux x86-64 and aarch64, Python 3.13 and the one lock is not established.
L01: PTC is experimental: selectable by explicit policy only (`T08-ptc-v1`); no qualified family. V14 clause (b) is carried as FAIL (ADR 0021 D3; on PTC-R1, PTC ends at the saddle from 149 starts).
L02: A zero-duty lifted flash whose root lies exactly on its dew or bubble point is `UNVERIFIED`, `RANK_DEFICIENT`; nearby two-phase-attempt stops are caught `FAILED(false_success_detected)`.

L03: The alias-pressure-shift limit: the pressure column at 0-based position j is certifiable iff 997 (j + 1) <= max(200 000 - P, P - 50 000) Pa; beyond it the alias certificates are `unsupported(pressure_shift_outside_domain)` and the verdict `UNVERIFIED` (spec §5.4).
L04: A saturation-closure failure inside the rows' own window is `FAILED`, where `UNVERIFIED(label_not_demonstrated)` would be exact (conservative).
L05: `VERIFIED` certifies residuals at registered tolerances; the solution-error bound is recorded, not promised.
L06: Energy checks share the property provider with the solver ([A09]).

L07: Bitwise float reproduction is reported, never promised; per-start ensemble outcomes differ across architectures. LU pivot-path diagnostics (`u_diag_min_abs`, `u_diag_max_abs`, `u_diagonal_ratio`, `nnz_L`, `nnz_U`) are recorded and not compared across platforms (ADR 0025 D4).
L08: Property-call counts are within-platform diagnostics; the terminal-refinement core (ADR 0018) can exhaust the property budget where `newton` finishes.
L09: The robustness claim is the nominal profile only; the stress profiles were not run.

L10: The initializer chain is partial (blueprint §7.4, K03 §10.1): GUESS-role specifications are not bound by the revision binder (such revisions run on `legacy_eo`), the SYN-001 tear path has its registered initializer only, and the one fallback between initializer sources is `T08-warm-v1`'s compatible warm start → traversal (opt-in; L-WS-1, L-WS-2).
L11: Cancellation: `verify` has no cooperative checkpoint; a region's events are lost on interrupt.
L12: Agent evidence: one pinned model and configuration, MCP only, not out of sample (CP lower bound 0.681); T09 0/6, T10 1/3; INJ-4 never exposed.
L13: `worker.log` is readable through `get_artifact`.
L14: The v0.1 rank rule is exactly one freed column per promoted target.
L15: Linux x86-64 and aarch64 only; Python 3.13; the one lock.
L16: IDAES agreement holds at the registered near-sharp SmoothVLE ε only.
L17: The reference environment's DWSIM runs on .NET 8, end of life 2026-11-10.
L-CSTR-1: The kinetic CSTR's rate law and coolant model are synthetic (the Frank-Kamenetskii γ → ∞ form and a coolant capacity rate); no Arrhenius or physical-conductance claim is made.
L-CSTR-2: An adiabatic, dormant kinetic CSTR's outlet temperature is a singularity (T05 §4.7 (a)); v0.1 does not certify an EO solve in which it appears.
L-CSTR-3: The kinetic CSTR's causal evaluator is a local model initializer (the isothermal state at `T_init`), not a steady state.
L-WS-1: Warm-start compatibility is exact id-set identity; a topology edit is a typed rejection to the next source, not a partial or adapted match.
L-WS-2: The warm-start source is chosen automatically (the lineage's latest VERIFIED state) under an opt-in policy only; no request-named source exists in v0.1 (v0.2, M03).
L18: Nothing in v0.1 is empirically validated: SYN-001 is synthetic (pseudo-components, invented constants, ideal VLE), and every result is numerical verification against the same equations.

L19: Certificates are local: the regularity screen and the error bound hold at the certified state only. No root completeness, uniqueness, thermodynamic stability beyond the admissibility check, or dynamic stability is assessed (`claims` stay NOT_ASSESSED).

L20: Convergence is not guaranteed wherever a root exists: registered counterexamples end typed (PHS-05 without edge 3; HOM-03/HOM-04 stall at a phase boundary); folds are not followed (no arclength continuation).
L21: Specification continuation (edge 3's homotopy) exists only for regions with a promoted specification; elsewhere it is `unsupported(no_continuation_parameter)`.

L22: Scope of the solver evidence: tear selection is greedy (minimality not claimed); behaviour finer than the registered basin margins and trajectories below a residual of 1e-6 are not established; several stated rules are exercised only by synthetic fixtures.

L36: No performance claim at size: costs are within-platform measurements on registered cases of at most tens of variables; compiles per plan run and the regularity screen's cost at size are not measured.

L37: `verify` is not safe to run concurrently in threads of one process: the regularity screen seeds and restores numpy's global generator around `onenormest` (T06 §8.1, R-069), so concurrent calls can move the estimate, `rcond₁`, the bound and a regularity verdict near its threshold; jobs run in separate processes and are unaffected.

L38: Structural analysis is generic: validation's STR checks and `inspect_structure` report structural rank and the DM/BTF partition only; numerical rank, conditioning and feasibility are judged by the certificate's regularity screen at a converged state (blueprint D05).
L39: The structural-zero release (recovery edge E5) leaves no trace record: a trace does not show that it ran.
L23: More than one recycle loop or region per plan is not exercised by any registered flowsheet; the plan builder's single-loop reading is to be revisited when one is (T02 review N8).
L24: Not implemented: Wegstein and Aitken acceleration, trust regions, Krylov linear solves, arclength continuation.
L25: Alias certificates cover pressure and temperature copies only (the kinds ADR 0001 D6 gives a tolerance); any other affine redundancy is `uncertified_affine`, retained and listed.

L26: SYN-001's symmetric data leave paths unexercised: component discrimination in liquid enthalpy, a liquid heat of reaction (every liquid reaction is thermoneutral), an exchanger with a phase change or temperature-dependent c_p (refused).
L27: An EO solve with a dormant PH-type outlet is never certified (UNVERIFIED, RANK_DEFICIENT; T05 §4.7 (a), R-050).
L28: A single flowing component inside its latent jump is solved causally only; on the EO path it ends typed or not VERIFIED, never VERIFIED (T05 §4.7 (b), R-050).
L29: The PH kernel's accuracy for near-pure feeds is the energy tolerance's resolution; a target inside the latent jump may be refused `ph_ill_conditioned` (T05 §4.4, R-049).

L30: Degenerate specifications are reported, not certified: a TP outlet of one component at exactly T_sat, conditioning near β → 0 or 1, and a zero-flow SPECIFICATION_CONFLICT (not searched past); a dormant exchanger side gets no second-law judgement.
L31: A state whose verifier projection is refused is judged at its final state: a possible false alarm, never a false pass.
L32: The ensemble gate's run 2 is not out of sample for `T06-revision-v2` (its last change was informed by these draws); the holdout (436 of 440 on every class) is the out-of-sample estimate.

L33: Scope defaults of T06 §16: results are keyed by component id; a TWO_PHASE split with a vanishing phase is not converted by the solver (the verifier catches the label); three F-BUDGET starts have no cost remedy.
L34: A replay bundle references the CasADi wheel by hash and does not embed it; a replay needs the wheel to remain fetchable.
L35: A tear-path solve that exhausts its budget records `attempts = 0`, the start state and no provenance (K03's registered capped-budget shape).

L40: The reference-tool data (the IDAES and DWSIM environments, their downloads and their outputs) and OpenIDAES-450 are not distributed: the sdist and the wheel carry the project's own code, its package data and its licence files only, and every ComponentRecord is synthetic (SYN-001).

L41: A bundle written by an installed package (wheel or sdist, not the source checkout) carries no dependency-set identity: the package ships no lock file, so its `lock_sha256` is empty and every replay of it is `inspected_archived_results` / `NOT_RUN` ("the dependency set is unknown …"); replayable bundles are written from the source checkout at the lock `ead4edf1…`.
